rating_method: Davidson three-outcome Elo; updates after all matches of same date; league-isolated ratings
selection: Global calendar validation only; separate calibration window; final period used for exploratory reporting only

protocol.split_rule: global unique dates: first 55% training, next 15% selection, next 10% calibration, last 20% evaluation
protocol.features: expanding origin; results strictly before each match date, same-day batch never updates before prediction
protocol.selection: Elo and ensemble weight on validation only; temperatures on later calibration only; holdout used for reporting only
protocol.uncertainty: ISO-week cluster bootstrap; bins show descriptive Wilson intervals assuming independent events
protocol.holdout_warning: History was already inspected in earlier research; this is an exploratory re-analysis, not a fresh confirmatory holdout.

limitations: Retrospective source snapshots do not prove historical publication availability.
Previously inspected history cannot establish prospective superiority.
Week blocks capture same-week dependence, not all persistent team/season dependence.
Calibration-bin Wilson intervals assume independent events; they are descriptive, not per-match probability intervals.
No referee, confirmed lineup, injury or tactical variables; no validated ROI.

market_diagnostic.source: Previously stored international bookmaker no-vig consensus snapshots
market_diagnostic.warning: The odds consensus is not objective ground truth; this is not a betting profitability test.
